approach: One helper decides where records are read from: the tip of refs/heads/athena/records when it exists and holds a records/ tree, else the working tree's records/ (pre-cutover fallback). Tree readers (Records::load, RecordSet::load and everything built on them) get a "current" entry point that swaps the treeish for the branch tip. Filesystem readers (read_records, walltime, study site generator, backtest) get a root: a detached worktree of the branch at one fixed path under the repo state directory, created or fast-forwarded on demand. The branch keeps records/... paths, so only the root moves. All changes and tests stay inside the brief's deliverable files: tests are in-module #[cfg(test)] tests, with no new test file and no file outside the list.

decisions.choice: Define the worktree directory name and records_worktree_path once in athena-data lib.rs (beside repo_state_dir); the ensure/refresh helper and treeish resolver live in athena-core store.rs; every reader calls them.
decisions.reason: Criterion 3 and the mechanism default: one definition is structural. An in-module scan test in xtask/src/main.rs fails on stray join("records") readers outside an allow-list.

demonstrations.method: In-module tests (store.rs, gate records.rs/audit.rs, cli main.rs, xtask main.rs) build a scratch repo with a records/ fixture, run import_records at C0, then for each named reader compare the result with no branch (records/ in tree) against the result from the branch worktree after records/ is removed from the tree. Test names share the prefix records_branch_readers_.
demonstrations.observes: Records::load_current, RecordSet::load_current, read_records, walltime, status, forecast, scoring, retry carry, audit, introspection and site generator give equal, non-empty results from both sources.
demonstrations.fails_without: A reader still reading the working tree sees nothing once records/ is deleted, so its output is empty and differs.

demonstrations.method: A test in crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs calls the status and forecast command handlers (output captured) on a scratch checkout with ATHENA_STATE_DIR set to a tempdir, after import and removal of records/ from the tree, and compares to the run with records/.
demonstrations.observes: Both succeed and output matches the records/ run.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the redirect, status and forecast see no records and error or differ.
